title: 建築構造計画
subtitle: Structural Planning for Architecture
keywords: Structural system 2.Structural design load 3.Seismic design 4.DX(Structural analysis) 5.Regional cooperation(Timber structure)
educationalGoal: Learn basic knowledge about building structures and materials, and develop the ability to show structural plans to plan and design mechanically rational building spaces.
advice: ■Learn the basics of structural planning to be safe from loads and external forces, and to select structural types, shapes, materials, and member arrangements from the mechanical standpoint that are suitable for the intended use of the building. A basic knowledge of materials and structural mechanics is required. ■Course Outline 1. Materials, structural types, loads 2. External forces, structural systems 3. Beam and column planning 4. Foundation structure planning 5. Collapse load 6. Structural designers' ideas and examples of structural planning 7. Review of external forces, introduction of structural analysis tools 8. Earthquake mechanisms and calculation of seismic forces 9. Structural planning for vertical and horizontal forces 10. Deformation and torsional behavior of structures
books: textbooks:none reference Material speaks Timber and structural space, Norihide Imagawa / Mechanics Material Structural design, Yoshiaki Tsuboi, et.al reserved books:none
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of Introduction of the structure (1st phase) and Structural Mechanics for Architecture Ⅰ (2nd term) and Ⅱ (3rd term) is required.

activityGoals.body: Explain the basic characteristics of structural materials and the features of structural systems.
Explain the characteristics of loads, external forces, and building damage caused by natural disaster.
Calculate collapse load and deformation using the virtual work method and analysis tool.
Explain the concepts of seismic design.
Examine the earthquake resistance of small houses and explain the reinforcement.
